queries.text: The Schopenhauer line is translated from the author’s Portuguese; the source passage in Schopenhauer was not identified, so no published English wording was used.

translator_notes.text: “Inferno astral” is a common Brazilian expression (from popular astrology) for a stretch of bad luck and troubles; rendered literally as “astral hell,” since the author also uses it in its esoteric sense of an inner, psychic hell.
